body: Built for off-grid travel and everyday comfort, this 2025 Mercedes Sprinter 144 AWD camper van in the El Capitan build tier includes premium power, solar, air conditioning, diesel heat, a full kitchen, indoor shower, convertible sleeping setup, and upgraded adventure features.

Inside, the van features a clean blue and white interior with stained wood accents, shiplap walls, luxury vinyl flooring, smart storage, a lifting bed system, and a converting dinette layout designed for life on the road.
